relationships.subject: CGRP receptor antagonists
relationships.evidence_quote: both given intrathecally, blocked, and reversed hyperalgesic priming only in females

relationships.subject: anti-CGRP monoclonal antibody
relationships.evidence_quote: A monoclonal antibody against CGRP, given systemically, blocked priming specifically in female rodents but failed to reverse it.

relationships.subject: CGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: intrathecally applied CGRP caused a long-lasting, dose-dependent mechanical hypersensitivity in female mice but more transient effects in males

relationships.subject: olcegepant
relationships.evidence_quote: This CGRP-induced mechanical hypersensitivity was reversed by olcegepant and the KCC2 enhancer CLP257

relationships.subject: CLP257
relationships.evidence_quote: This CGRP-induced mechanical hypersensitivity was reversed by olcegepant and the KCC2 enhancer CLP257

relationships.subject: CLP257
relationships.evidence_quote: CLP257 alleviated hyperalgesic priming in male and female mice

relationships.subject: CGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: Therefore, CGRP may regulate KCC2 expression and/or activity downstream of CGRP receptors specifically in females.

key_findings: Intrathecal CGRP receptor antagonists blocked and reversed IL-6-induced hyperalgesic priming only in female rodents, and intrathecal CGRP produced long-lasting mechanical hypersensitivity in female but transient effects in male mice.
CGRP depolarized GABAA reversal potentials in dorsal horn neurons only in females, and the KCC2 enhancer CLP257 reversed CGRP-induced hypersensitivity, implicating anionic plasticity.
